description: Defines types, constants, and functions for handling time representations and conversions in the EzTime library, including structures for exploded time, time zones, and functions for getting current time, exploding, and imploding time values.

methods.name: EzTimeTFromSbTime
methods.description: Converts a 64-bit integer representing time in SbTime format to EzTimeT, handling POSIX epoch offset and microsecond conversion.

methods.name: EzTimeTToSbTime
methods.description: Converts EzTimeT to SbTime format, handling microsecond conversion and POSIX epoch offset.

methods.name: EzTimeValueFromSbTime
methods.description: Converts SbTime in int64_t to EzTimeValue struct with seconds and microseconds.

methods.name: EzTimeValueToSbTime
methods.description: Converts EzTimeValue struct to SbTime in int64_t.

methods.name: EzTimeTExplode
methods.description: Explodes EzTimeT into EzTimeExploded structure for a given timezone.

methods.name: EzTimeValueExplode
methods.description: Explodes EzTimeValue into EzTimeExploded structure and milliseconds for a given timezone.

methods.name: EzTimeTImplode
methods.description: Implodes EzTimeExploded into EzTimeT for a given timezone.

methods.name: EzTimeValueImplode
methods.description: Implodes EzTimeExploded and milliseconds into EzTimeValue for a given timezone.

methods.name: EzTimeValueGetNow
methods.description: Gets current time as EzTimeValue, drop-in replacement for gettimeofday().

methods.name: EzTimeTGetNow
methods.description: Gets current time as EzTimeT, drop-in replacement for time().

methods.name: EzTimeTExplodeLocal
methods.description: Explodes EzTimeT to local time EzTimeExploded.

methods.name: EzTimeTExplodeUTC
methods.description: Explodes EzTimeT to UTC time EzTimeExploded.

methods.name: EzTimeTImplodeLocal
methods.description: Implodes local time EzTimeExploded into EzTimeT.

methods.name: EzTimeTImplodeUTC
methods.description: Implodes UTC time EzTimeExploded into EzTimeT.
